**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Match the recorded PID to this exact ngrok tunnel**

Fresh evidence after the stale-PID remediation is that the new guard accepts any command line containing `ngrok http`, not this script's binary, backend, and config. If a stale PID is reused by another ngrok tunnel under the shared LAB account, a missing or mismatched `ngrok.addr` makes `start_nohup` signal that unrelated tunnel; `remote-stop.sh` uses the same permissive test and can escalate to `kill -9`. Compare the live command's normalized backend/config with `ADDR` and `CONFIG`, otherwise discard the PID without signaling it.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Keep the historical Octopus receipt on its actual host**

Fresh evidence after the deployment README correction is that this authoritative batch still attributes `20260929T015822Z-octopus-payton-desktop.md` to LAB-OMARCHY. The cited receipt explicitly records PAYTON-DESKTOP/PAYTON-OMARCHY at `192.168.0.149`, while the corrected deployment READMEs state that no LAB-OMARCHY Octopus receipt exists. Ingesting this batch therefore publishes false deployment evidence; retain the PAYTON attribution and leave the LAB deployment as not run.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Stop mapping the PAYTON assertion to the LAB host AC**

This test is tagged as coverage for `AC-RIDE-072-005`, whose disk-batch text permits go-by-default on LAB-OMARCHY and PAYTON-LEGION2, but the test later requires PAYTON-DESKTOP and never checks LAB-OMARCHY. A CI run filtered to `AC-RIDE-072-005` can therefore pass while asserting the opposite host policy; the ledger itself acknowledges this host-set conflict and defers the AC. Remove this trait until the policy is resolved, or make the assertion match the authoritative AC.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Remove the retired bundle from the implementation plan**

The retirement only strikes FR-RIDE-038 in this row while leaving live TEST-RIDE-023 described as “Multi-driver provenance and counsel bundle”; the canonical testing batch now calls it “Per-record provenance,” and the bundle RPC, TR-RIDE-SERVER-007, and UC-RIDE-016 are removed. The same plan still titles P8 as the counsel multi-driver bundle phase, so an implementer following it is directed to recreate functionality that this change deliberately retired. Rewrite the live TEST-RIDE-023/P8 scope around independent per-record verification.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Test the access export under TEST-RIDE-010**

The authoritative TEST-RIDE-010 row was narrowed to “DSAR access export” and explicitly says no deletion test was invented, while the FR-RIDE-010 mapping still points only to TEST-RIDE-010. This sole TEST-RIDE-010 trait now labels a deletion-only test that never calls `Privacy.Export`; the export assertions elsewhere run under TEST-RIDE-031 or no TEST trait. Consequently the mapped acceptance run can pass even if access export is broken. Move this trait and the AC-TEST-010 traits onto an export test, or remap the requirement.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Exercise the production BLE service filter**

This new coverage test proves RideAudit-only discovery only with `InMemoryDiscoveryBus`; for the production Windows adapter it merely checks that the UUID symbol appears in source. When `ServiceUuids.Add` throws on an unpackaged Windows host, `WindowsBleDiscoveryBus.Scan` deliberately continues with an unfiltered watcher and labels every named advertisement as `RideAuditBluetooth`, so a foreign BLE peer can be surfaced despite AC-RIDE-053-003. The static assertion still passes in that scenario; test the adapter fallback behavior and fail closed instead of scanning without the service filter.
